response.sql: WITH order_averages AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) as avg_fillcount FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), global_avg AS (SELECT AVG(fillcount) as global_avg_fillcount FROM orderexecutions), first_filter AS (SELECT oa.ordersmark, oa.avg_fillcount, (oa.avg_fillcount - ga.global_avg_fillcount) as margin_over_global FROM order_averages oa CROSS JOIN global_avg ga WHERE oa.avg_fillcount > ga.global_avg_fillcount), filtered_group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as filtered_avg_fillcount FROM first_filter), second_filter AS (SELECT ff.ordersmark, ff.avg_fillcount, ff.margin_over_global, (ff.avg_fillcount - fga.filtered_avg_fillcount) as margin_over_filtered FROM first_filter ff CROSS JOIN filtered_group_avg fga WHERE ff.avg_fillcount > fga.filtered_avg_fillcount) SELECT AVG(sf.avg_fillcount) as final_avg_fillcount, AVG(sf.margin_over_global) as avg_margin_over_global, AVG(sf.margin_over_filtered) as avg_margin_over_filtered FROM second_filter sf
